---
title: "GAIA Lab"
# A logo é servida localmente (icon/) para carregar junto com o resto da
# página; as imagens padrão são os fallbacks de fotos quebradas no site todo.
# images/hero/ traz imagens usadas no fundo do hero.
resources:
  - "icon/"
  - "images/hero/"
  - "images/areas/"
  - "images/home/"
  - "images/avatar-default.svg"
  - "images/paper-default.svg"
# Cards da equipe: até quatro avatares reais de cada grupo, via listagem.
listing:
  - id: home-docentes
    contents:
      - "people/*/*.en.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: ["professor", "postdoc"]
    template: _ejs/avatar-stack.ejs
    sort: title
    max-items: 4
    fields: [title, image]
  - id: home-pos
    contents:
      - "people/*/*.en.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: ["phd", "masters"]
    template: _ejs/avatar-stack.ejs
    sort: title
    max-items: 4
    fields: [title, image]
  - id: home-graduacao
    contents:
      - "people/*/*.en.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "undergrad"
    template: _ejs/avatar-stack.ejs
    sort: title
    max-items: 4
    fields: [title, image]
  - id: home-rede
    contents:
      - "people/*/*.en.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: ["colaborador", "alumni"]
    template: _ejs/avatar-stack.ejs
    sort: title
    max-items: 4
    fields: [title, image]
page-layout: custom
body-classes: "home"
toc: false
---

<div class="home-body">
  <section id="home-pesquisa" class="home-section reveal">
    <h2 class="section-title">Research applied to socio-environmental challenges</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">
      We combine massive satellite streams and deep learning to tackle critical
      ecological and production bottlenecks across four priority axes. From agricultural
      plot scale to urban dynamics, we turn complex satellite pixels into actionable
      territorial insights.
    </p>
    <div class="home-areas">
      <a class="area-card reveal" href="research/#agriculture">
        <img class="area-card-bg" src="images/areas/agricultura.webp" alt="" loading="lazy">
        <div class="area-card-top">
          <span class="card-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
            </svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="area-card-overlay">
          <div class="area-title">Agriculture</div>
          <div class="area-text">Crop classification and vegetation index series at plot scale.</div>
          <div class="area-kpi">359,600 plots<span>across 5 states, from 2020 to 2025</span></div>
        </div>
      </a>
      <a class="area-card reveal" href="research/#forests">
        <img class="area-card-bg" src="images/areas/floresta.webp" alt="" loading="lazy">

            </svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="area-card-overlay">
          <div class="area-title">Forests</div>
          <div class="area-text">Satellite forest segmentation, validated against official INPE data.</div>
          <div class="area-kpi">0.85 IoU<span>across 26 quarters, from 2020 to 2026</span></div>
        </div>
      </a>
      <a class="area-card reveal" href="research/#climate">

            </svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="area-card-overlay">
          <div class="area-title">Climate</div>
          <div class="area-text">Climate trends and agricultural risk in 15-year windows.</div>
          <div class="area-kpi">+1.1 °C peak<span>Nova Mutum, MT, 2011 to 2025</span></div>
        </div>
      </a>
      <a class="area-card reveal" href="research/#cities">

            </svg>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="area-card-overlay">

          <div class="area-text">Characterization of urban settlements and socioeconomic analysis.</div>
          <div class="area-kpi">Urban sensing<span>Mapping and vulnerability</span></div>
        </div>
      </a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="home-section reveal">
    <h2 class="section-title">How we work: from orbit to actionable intelligence</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">
      Our methodological pipeline connects multimodal satellite constellations,
      meteorological reanalyses, and deep learning architectures into an end-to-end
      framework, validated against official records and committed to reproducible science.
    </p>

    <div class="stats reveal">
      <div><div class="stat-num" data-count="359596" data-thousands=",">0</div><div class="stat-label">Plots mapped</div></div>
      <div><div class="stat-num" data-count="897">0</div><div class="stat-label">Municipalities</div></div>
      <div><div class="stat-num" data-count="5">0</div><div class="stat-label">States</div></div>
      <div><div class="stat-num">2020 to 2026</div><div class="stat-label">Data period</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="hscroll-wrap reveal">
      <button class="hscroll-btn prev" aria-label="Previous step"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button>
      <div class="hscroll">
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">01</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Multimodal ingestion</div><div class="hs-text">Continuous acquisition of satellite constellations (optical and SAR radar), climate reanalyses, and institutional corpora.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">02</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Spatiotemporal harmonisation</div><div class="hs-text">Atmospheric correction, cloud masking, and multi-year time series alignment at territorial scale.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">03</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Deep learning and foundation models</div><div class="hs-text">Semantic segmentation, geospatial foundation models, and applied language models for complex representations.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">04</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Auditing and official validation</div><div class="hs-text">Systematic benchmarking against INPE field references (DETER and PRODES), ZARC zoning, MapBiomas, and uncertainty metrics.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">05</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Actionable intelligence</div><div class="hs-text">Generation of risk indicators, territorial monitoring tools, and open-source code supporting decision-makers.</div></article>
      </div>
      <button class="hscroll-btn next" aria-label="Next step"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="m9 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
    </div>
    <div class="section-cta">
      <a class="pub-btn" href="about/">Learn more about our approach</a>
    </div>
  </section>

        <p>
          The lab also trains researchers through theses, dissertations and capstone projects
